issues.summary: Moving AccumulateType definitions to headeronly breaks backward compatibility, so the PR needs a BC-breaking note written to the project guidelines.
Generic helper macros such as ACC_TYPE can redefine and then #undef macros the caller already defined; prefix them with TORCH_HEADERONLY_.
The docs say acc_type/acc_type_device give a 'wider' dtype, but the accumulate type isn't always wider; change the wording.
